export_files.file_description: This file contains patient’s claim charges details.

fields.name: PatientSys
fields.description: Unique identifier of the patient

fields.name: PatientID
fields.description: myUnity internal identifier. Use this value to associate all files to the same patient

fields.name: Patient_PreferredName
fields.description: Patient’s preferred name

fields.name: InvoiceSys
fields.description: Unique integer value that associates the claim/patient statement to the claim details and charges

fields.name: ChargeID
fields.description: Unique integer value that represents the charge detail that is associated to the claim/patient statement

fields.name: ServiceDate
fields.description: Date in which the services were provided. This may match the start date of the claim/patient statement

fields.name: PostDate
fields.description: This is the date in which the charge was posted as a charge in the myUnity system

fields.name: ChargeDescription
fields.description: Description of the charge detail

fields.name: RevenueCode
fields.description: Revenue codes are a standardized system that identifies any accommodations and specific services provided to patients in a healthcare setting

fields.name: CPTCode
fields.description: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT®) codes offer doctors and health care professionals a uniform language for coding medical services and procedures to streamline reporting, increase accuracy and efficiency. This may also report Healthcare Common procedure Coding System (HCPCS) that is divided into two principal subsystems, referred to as level I and level II of the HCPCS

fields.name: Modifier1
fields.description: When reporting HCPCS values on the claim/patient statement, it is possible to have additional modifiers that provide

fields.name: Modifier2
fields.description: When reporting HCPCS values on the claim/patient statement, it is possible to have additional modifiers that provide additional details in to that charge. This can be represented by up to 4 additional 2 character code modifiers for each charge detail line

fields.name: Modifier3
fields.description: When reporting HCPCS values on the claim/patient statement, it is possible to have additional modifiers that provide additional details in to that charge. This can be represented by up to 4 additional 2 character code modifiers for each charge detail line

fields.name: Modifier4
fields.description: When reporting HCPCS values on the claim/patient statement, it is possible to have additional modifiers that provide additional details in to that charge. This can be represented by up to 4 additional 2 character code modifiers for each charge detail line

fields.name: ChargeQuantity
fields.description: Summation of the total Quantity: the quantity in the vendor's unit of measure, as defined for the vendor item. For example, if the vendor's unit of measure is 15 minutes, and services provided was 1 hour, the quantity is 4 (4 * 15 minutes = 60 minutes or 1 hour)

fields.name: UnitAmount
fields.description: Summation of the unit of measure. If measuring by minutes and a service was performed for 1 hour, this would be 60 minutes reported

fields.name: ChargeAmount
fields.description: Summation of the total charges that appear on this charge detail

fields.name: AuthorizationNumber
fields.description: When payers require authorizations for services rendered, this will report the authorization number that was provided by the payer (typically through a prior authorization that has been confirmed by the biller)

fields.description: Date in which the adjustment to this transaction/service was created. This would be to identify when payments, write-offs, forward charges, etc. have been entered in associated to the charge

fields.name: TransactionAmount
fields.description: The dollar amount of the adjustment to the transaction. This may be a positive or negative number
